recognize_zh: CD45 對 SSC 散佈圖中，P3 閘門（藍色）圈出 SSC 低、CD45 弱至中度表現的族群，位置正好是芽細胞區；上方紅色 SSC 較高者為成熟顆粒球。
features: Dot plot of CD45 (APC-H7, log scale) versus side scatter (SSC-A, linear)
Gated P3 population (blue) with low SSC and dim-to-moderate CD45: the typical blast region
Large ungated population (red) with intermediate to high SSC and brighter CD45, corresponding to granulocytes
Minor CD45-negative/low events at low SSC, likely debris or non-hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot of left knee joint fluid shows a distinct population with low side scatter and dim to moderate CD45 expression, gated as P3 and consistent with the blast gate. A larger population with higher side scatter and brighter CD45 represents admixed granulocytes. This plot identifies the gated blast population, whose lineage must be assigned with additional markers (CD34, CD117, CD13/CD33, MPO). Findings support the presence of a blast population in the joint fluid in the setting of acute myeloid leukemia.
